npcs.name: Sigrun Tovesdottir
npcs.idle: Hallvard. You haven't seen a big, slow, kind man called Hallvard? No. Of course not.

npcs.name: Old Grima
npcs.idle: The hidden folk are older than the jarls. Older than the gods, some say. Only fools say it loudly.

npcs.name: Bjarki Houndmaster
npcs.idle: A good hound is worth three huscarls. Don't tell the huscarls.

quests.title: The Huldra's Bargain
quests.offer:
Hallvard and I are to be wed at midsummer. Or we were. He went into the western woods to cut timber for our house, and came back once, a week ago - singing, smelling of pine and cream - and went straight back out again.

Old [Grima] says it's a huldra. One of the hidden folk. Will you [find Hallvard]? Before midsummer, if you can.

topics.Grima: Old Grima, by the well. She knows every story worth knowing.

quests.summary: Sigrun's betrothed went into the western woods to cut timber and came back singing - then went back to the hidden folk.

steps.goal: Ask Old Grima about the hidden folk
steps.say: A huldra. Fair as morning from the front, and a cow's [tail] behind - that's how you know. She'll have a camp in the west, with her kin. If a huldra weds a man under the gods, she loses the tail and becomes a woman. They want that very much. Some of them want it more than they want the man.

steps.text: Somewhere ahead, someone is singing - a man, badly, and a woman, beautifully.
The hidden folk fade back into the trees, watching. They don't seem to want to fight. They seem to want you to leave.

clue.name: a woodsman's axe, left in a stump

steps.text: Hallvard's axe, its edge rusting. He hasn't cut a tree in a week. Beyond the tents, in the firelight, a big man sits with a beautiful woman's head on his shoulder.

steps.say:
Sigrun sent you? Oh. Oh, Sigrun.

This is Ylva. Look at her. She says she'll lose her tail if we wed at the temple, and be a woman, and grow old with me. She cried when she said it. Nobody's ever cried over me. I don't know what to [do].

I promised Sigrun. I did. But I didn't know there was this. Tell me.

Should I [wed Ylva]? Or should you [break the glamour] and drag me home by the beard? Ylva's father won't let me go easy, if you do.

options.say: ...Yes. Yes. Tell Sigrun I'm sorry. Tell her she'll find someone who deserves her. I mean that.
Then do it quick, before I change my mind - her father's coming. Gods, look at the size of him.

steps.text: The old hill-man falls. Ylva is gone - only a scent of pine. Hallvard blinks like a man waking up.

stages.name: Old Grumme of the Hidden Folk
stages.announce: An old huldu man rises from the fire, horns and all. 'He's promised to my girl. You'll not take him.'

boss.name: Old Grumme of the Hidden Folk

stages.success: Old Grumme of the Hidden Folk falls.

steps.say:
He's home. He looks like a man who woke up from a lovely dream into a cold morning, and he says sorry every hour.

I'll take him. Sorry and all. Midsummer's still a month off.

He's marrying her. A huldra. At the temple, so she can be a woman.

Then I hope she's a better one than me, because I'm going to hate her for the rest of my life. ...No. That's not fair. Take this. It was meant for the wedding.

home.text: Take this - for bringing him home.

wed.text: It was meant for the wedding.

quests.title: The Houndmaster's Law
quests.offer:
My hounds went mad in a night. Foaming, howling, gone west into the moor. Gormr led them - my son's dog. My son's dead two winters, and Gormr's all of him I've got.

Gormr bit a child before he ran. The jarl's law says a dog that bites a child is killed. I know the law. Will you [find my hounds] and find out what did this? I'll deal with the law after.
quests.summary: Bjarki Houndmaster's hounds went mad and ran west, led by his dead son's dog.

steps.text: Hounds - Bjarki's hounds - roam the heather, foaming at the mouth, savage and lost.

steps.goal: Put down the worst of the rabid hounds
steps.text: Every one wears Bjarki's brass tag. Every one had drunk from the same spring - their muzzles are stained with its grey water.
Bone fetishes, strung on sinew and sunk in the spring - vendo work. The water is grey with curse. Tracks of clawed feet lead north, to the vendo camps.

steps.goal: Kill the vendo shaman who cursed the spring
steps.text: The bone-singer's chant chokes off. Far to the south, all at once, the howling stops.

stages.name: Bone-Singer Grakka
stages.announce: A vendo in a mask of skulls rises out of a pile of bones, rattling and singing. 'Dog-man's dogs! Dog-man's dogs, mad and mine!'

steps.say:
The fever's broken. Look at them - lying in the grass like puppies, sorry for themselves. And Gormr. Gormr's here.

He's himself again. But he bit the Sveinsson girl. The jarl's law is the law: you saw it, so you must say. Do I [keep the law]? Or do we [say nothing], and Gormr was never found?

options.say: ...Yes. I'll do it myself. He's my son's dog. He'll not die by a stranger's hand. Go back to Fort Veldon. I'll follow.
Never found. Lost on the moor. Aye. Aye. Gods forgive us both. Come on, boy. Come on, Gormr.

steps.say:
It's done. He didn't fight. He licked my hand.

The jarl thanked me for my loyalty. I nearly hit him. Here. Gormr's collar. I can't keep it in the house.

Gormr was never found, if anyone asks. Lost on the moor.

He's asleep under my bed. Snoring. Here - take something. You've given me back more than a dog.
